profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. Its site invites students and educators to learn, teach, and study through the service, and it presents itself as a way to get unstuck on coursework. The site also carries sample academic questions, such as prompts on theoretical perspectives in lifespan development and on home-school partnerships for exceptional learners. Course Hero states that it is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university, and identifies itself as a Learneo, Inc. business.

The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City. Its tracked product is QuillBot, listed under writing and editing with a note of paraphrasing, which places the company in the AI-assisted writing and study tools space alongside its core library of course materials and tutoring.

No litigation, MCP server, or other registry facts are recorded for Course Hero.
